functions.description: scores area-attack targets and dispatches grouped entries
functions.lever: bare C89 declarations in searched order, -1 derived from live 0 (value/spread before bestIndex), output pointers bound before the target load, savedEntry address written inline so its LICM temp takes the higher spill slot
functions.notes: Size and shape match exactly (0x48c). What is left is register colouring plus one schedule. (1) actor wants sb and the loop counters r7; ours rotate actor/element/boosts/j across r6/r7/sb. Declaration-order hill climbs of about 2,500 compiles, shared vs split counters, shared vs split target local, and colorsweep all plateau at 50 bytes. (2) Range-table block at +0x184: the ROM issues the three table loads in IR order (pool 021ff004, 021ff002, 021ff003) with the row index in r3 and mvn -1 after the multi spill. Ours schedules 002/003 first because smulbb rows*columns sits in the same pass-1 block. It looks like a block split after the three loads (perhaps the 100-pcode rule), but no natural edit moved it. (3) +0x3cc: cmp r1,r2 comes out as cmp r2,r1 (next->side != target->side gets the loads right but flips the operands). frida/schedtrace.py fails here (module 'frida' has no attribute 'get_local_device'), so vdump/schedwhy could not be used.
